description: Na₄Ti₇O₁₆ crystallizes in the monoclinic Pm space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.11-2.46 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.20-2.41 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.14-2.78 Å. There are five inequivalent Ti sites. In the first Ti site, Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing TiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 46-48°. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.92-2.08 Å. In the second Ti site, Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing TiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 48-53°. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.90-2.10 Å. In the third Ti site, Ti is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.93-2.34 Å. In the fourth Ti site, Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing TiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 46-53°. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.88-2.20 Å. In the fifth Ti site, Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form edge-sharing TiO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.86-2.18 Å. There are twelve inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three Ti atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four Na and two equivalent Ti atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to one Na and three Ti atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to two Na and two Ti atoms to form distorted ONa₂Ti₂ trigonal pyramids that share corners with two ONa₂Ti₃ square pyramids, corners with two equivalent ONa₂Ti₂ trigonal pyramids, and edges with two ONa₂Ti₃ square pyramids. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to three Ti atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to three Ti atoms. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na and two Ti atoms. In the eighth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na and three Ti atoms to form ONa₂Ti₃ square pyramids that share corners with two equivalent ONa₂Ti₂ trigonal pyramids, edges with two equivalent ONa₃Ti₂ square pyramids, and edges with two equivalent ONa₂Ti₂ trigonal pyramids. In the ninth O site, O is bonded to three Na and two equivalent Ti atoms to form ONa₃Ti₂ square pyramids that share corners with two equivalent ONa₂Ti₂ trigonal pyramids, edges with two equivalent ONa₂Ti₃ square pyramids, and edges with two equivalent ONa₂Ti₂ trigonal pyramids. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to one Na and three Ti atoms. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three Ti atoms. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to three Ti atoms.
